scheme_name: Prime Minister’s Fellowship for Doctoral Research
other_conditions: The applicant must be an Indian citizen.
The applicant must be a full‑time PhD scholar enrolled in a recognized Indian university, institute or research laboratory.
The PhD registration date must be within 14 months of the application submission date (i.e., the applicant must apply within 14 months of admission/registration).
The applicant must have a valid industry partner who will financially support the research project and provide guidance/mentorship.
The research topic, agreed between the applicant and the industry partner, must be innovative, practically relevant, and have industrial application.
The selected applicant must be willing to work with or at the supporting company as required during the project period.
The applicant must not receive any other fellowship after selection.
benefits_summary: Provides a scholarship equal to double the standard JRF/SRF fellowship, with half funded by the government and half by the industry partner.
documents_required: Call for Proposal and Document Checklist
Signed undertaking from the industry partner
Signed undertaking from the host institute
